One-Liners

Production breakdowns that reduce each scene to its essential details.

66 production documentsOriginal archive materialPreserved by Boggsfiles

A one-line schedule condenses every scene into a quick production overview, typically noting the scene number, setting, time of day, principal action, cast, and key requirements. These documents helped the production team plan and track an episode before and during filming.
